name: Seated Cable Lateral Raise (Cable Under Legs)
alternative_names: Seated Lateral Raise Cable Between Legs
description: The seated cable lateral raise with the cable running under the legs is performed seated on a bench beside a cable, with the cable passing beneath the thighs to the working hand. This setup creates a unique loading angle where the cable pulls the working arm downward and inward at the bottom of the range, then shifts to a lateral pull at the top — providing a consistent tension profile that keeps the medial deltoid loaded at the bottom of the movement.

execution.starting_position: Sit on a flat bench beside a low cable pulley. The cable runs underneath the thighs to the working hand. Grip the handle with the far hand, arm resting across the thighs.
execution.setup_instructions: Sit close enough to the cable that the cable can run naturally under the legs. This may require a low bench or the floor.
steps: Step 1: Begin seated with the cable running under the thighs, working arm at side.
Step 2: Raise the working arm out to the side and upward to shoulder height.
Step 4: Lower under control — the cable will pull from beneath as you descend.
Step 5: Complete all reps then switch sides.
common_mistakes: Sitting too far from the cable — the cable should run smoothly under the legs
Raising above shoulder height — stop at horizontal for medial delt emphasis
safety_considerations: Ensure the cable path under the legs does not create a tripping hazard
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Arm across body to shoulder height laterally.
coaching_cues: Feel the tension from the very start of the movement
